LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_PsionicCore.label: Weave Psionic Core
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_PsionicCore.description: Using a psionic-tuned spatial curvature array, weave a Psionic Core out of a Shroud Crystal, Solar Crystal, Neutronium, Dark Matter, Gold and Jade.
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_GargantuaCore.label: Weave Gargantua Core
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_GargantuaCore.description: Fold a Psionic Core into an ultra-microscopic black hole, casing the singularity in Neutronium, Dark Matter, Solar-Forged Steel, Gold and Jade.
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_GoldenMiliraFeather.label: Weave Golden Milira Feather
LanguageData.GNH_Recipe_GoldenMiliraFeather.descripti: Infuse Milira feathers with Shroud ash and gold, weaving them into a Golden Milira Feather — the token the Imperium accepts in exchange for its rarest wares.
